audit.whatIsWrong: Overheat is framed as something Rumble wants to reach for extra burst.
audit.why: Junkyard Titan's Overheat at 100% Heat does grant attack speed and bonus auto damage, but it also makes him UNABLE TO CAST SPELLS for a few seconds. That silence-on-himself is the single best window in the lane and the page currently sells it as his plan rather than your opening.
audit.corrected: When he overheats he cannot cast anything for a few seconds — that is when you step up, not when you back off.

audit.whatIsWrong: His ability is called 'Equalizer' and no cooldowns are given.
audit.why: The ability is The Equalizer, 130/105/80s — one wall every two minutes early, so a spent R is a long window where your swing paths are open again. Flamespitter is 10/9/8/7/6s and Scrap Shield a flat 6s.
audit.corrected: The Equalizer is 130s at rank 1 — once it's down your terrain is usable again for two minutes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Electro Harpoon's magic-resist shred and its two charges are absent.
audit.why: Electro Harpoon reduces your magic resist as well as slowing, and he carries two at a time on a 0.5s recast — so the slow arrives twice and every point of MR you bought is worth less before the burn even starts. That, not just the slow, is why the Liandry's window kills you.
audit.corrected: Electro Harpoon comes in twos and shreds your magic resist on top of the slow, so MR alone does not answer his burn.

edits.before: Equalizer drops a long fire wall across the brush and terrain your Heroic Swing needs to hook, killing the swing path you live on.
edits.after: The Equalizer (130s) drops a fire wall across the brush and terrain your Heroic Swing needs to hook, killing the swing path you live on.

edits.before: Liandry's plus a heated Flamespitter out-sustains your lethality poke, and his E slow holds you in the burn through your passive shield.
edits.after: Liandry's plus a heated Flamespitter out-sustains your poke, and two Electro Harpoons slow you and shred your MR inside the burn.

edits.before: Land E harpoon to slow Akshan, then turn him into a fully-heated Flamespitter cone he can't walk out of
edits.after: Land both Electro Harpoons to slow you and shred your MR, then hold you in a fully-heated Flamespitter cone

edits.before: Bank heat to hit Overheat the moment Akshan steps up to Q, adding the empowered auto burst on top of Flamespitter
edits.after: Bank heat for the Danger Zone bonuses but stop short of Overheat, where he gains autos and cannot cast at all

edits.before: Drop Equalizer over the terrain Akshan hooks for Heroic Swing so his swing and escape route are denied
edits.after: Drop The Equalizer over the terrain Akshan hooks for Heroic Swing so his swing and escape route are denied

edits.before: His heat gauge and W shield plus move speed let Flamespitter out-sustain your trades, and the E harpoon slow catches you stepping up to Q.
edits.after: Danger Zone and the Scrap Shield let Flamespitter out-sustain your trades, and two Electro Harpoons slow you and cut your MR as you step up.

edits.before: Rumble has no dash and his Flamespitter does weak damage while un-heated, so levels 1-3 are the only part of this lane that's yours. Throw Q at the tip of its range, cancel your passive's second shot to grab the move speed, and chip him before he banks heat or finishes his W shield. Do NOT stand in his Flamespitter cone trying to all-in — it's sustained DPS that out-trades you the longer you sit in it, and it ramps as his heat climbs. Respect his E harpoon: it slows you and is his engage setup, so bait or sidestep it before you ever commit a Heroic Swing.
edits.after: Rumble has no dash and his Flamespitter does weak damage while un-heated, so levels 1-3 are the only part of this lane that's yours. Throw Q at the tip of its range, cancel your passive's second shot to grab the move speed, and chip him before he banks heat or finishes Scrap Shield. Do NOT stand in the Flamespitter cone trying to all-in — it out-trades you the longer you sit in it. Sidestep Electro Harpoon: it comes in twos, slows, and shreds your MR. And when his gauge tips into Overheat he cannot cast for a few seconds — that is your free window.

notes: 'The Equalizer' is the correct R name (the packet's suspectName flag was on the truncated 'Drop Equalizer' phrasing). Overheat was being presented as Rumble's goal; it also locks him out of casting, which is the clearest step-up window Akshan gets in this lane and it was nowhere on the page.
